blocks.text: AARVANTA LTD ("AARVANTA", "Company", "we", "our" or "us") is committed to protecting the privacy, confidentiality and security of personal data entrusted to us.

This Privacy Policy explains how personal data is collected, used, stored, disclosed and otherwise processed when individuals access or use the AARVANTA platform, websites, software applications, products and services, including Business OS available through os.aarvanta.co ("Platform").

We recognise our obligations under applicable data protection legislation and have implemented appropriate technical, organisational and administrative measures to safeguard personal data against unauthorised access, unlawful processing, accidental loss, destruction or damage.

This Privacy Policy applies to all individuals who access or interact with the Platform, including visitors, customers, account holders, authorised users, business clients, partners, prospective customers, affiliates and any individual whose personal data is processed through our services.
Where additional privacy notices apply to a specific product, feature or service, those notices supplement this Privacy Policy and prevail only to the extent of any inconsistency.
By accessing or using the Platform, you acknowledge that your personal data will be processed in accordance with this Privacy Policy.
The data controller responsible for processing personal data under this Privacy Policy is:

Unless expressly stated otherwise, AARVANTA LTD acts as the Data Controller for personal data collected through the Platform.

Where customers upload or process personal data belonging to their own clients, employees or third parties through Business OS, AARVANTA generally acts as a Data Processor and processes such information only in accordance with the customer's documented instructions and applicable law.

blocks.heading: This Privacy Policy applies to all personal data processed through
items: Any other products or services operated by AARVANTA LTD.

blocks.text: This Privacy Policy applies regardless of whether access occurs through desktop computers, laptops, tablets, mobile devices or any other internet-enabled device.
For the purposes of this Privacy Policy:

Applicable Data Protection Laws means all laws governing the processing of personal data, including but not limited to the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR), the EU General Data Protection Regulation (EU GDPR), the Data Protection Act 2018, the Privacy and Electronic Communications Regulations 2003 (PECR), together with any legislation replacing or amending them.
Business Customer means any organisation, company, partnership, sole trader or other legal entity using the Platform.
Customer Data means all information uploaded, imported, generated or stored within Business OS by or on behalf of customers.
Data Controller has the meaning given under the UK GDPR and EU GDPR.
Data Processor has the meaning given under the UK GDPR and EU GDPR.
Personal Data means any information relating to an identified or identifiable natural person.
Processing includes collection, recording, storage, organisation, structuring, adaptation, retrieval, consultation, disclosure, transmission, restriction, deletion and destruction of personal data.
Platform means Business OS together with all related products, services, APIs, software, websites and applications operated by AARVANTA LTD.
User means any individual accessing or using the Platform.
The Platform is intended solely for individuals who are at least 18 years of age.
By creating an account or using the Platform, you confirm that you are at least 18 years old and possess the legal capacity to enter into binding agreements under applicable law.
The Platform is not directed towards children.
We do not knowingly collect or process personal data relating to anyone under the age of 18.
If we become aware that personal data relating to a child has been collected without lawful authority, we will take reasonable steps to delete such information promptly.
Parents or legal guardians who believe that a child has provided personal data should contact us immediately.

blocks.text: The Platform uses cookies and similar technologies to distinguish users, improve functionality, maintain security, analyse usage patterns, remember user preferences and enhance the overall user experience.

Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit the Platform. Certain cookies are essential for the operation of the Platform and cannot be disabled without affecting core functionality.
Where required by applicable law, non-essential cookies will only be placed on your device after obtaining your consent through our cookie consent mechanism.
You may withdraw or modify your cookie preferences at any time through our Cookie Settings or by adjusting your browser settings.
Disabling certain cookies may affect the availability or functionality of specific features of the Platform.
The categories of cookies we use include, but are not limited to:

blocks.heading: Strictly Necessary Cookies

blocks.text: These cookies cannot be disabled because they are necessary for providing the services requested by the user.

blocks.heading: Functional Cookies
Analytics Cookies

blocks.text: Analytics information is generally aggregated and used to improve our products and services.

blocks.heading: Security Cookies

blocks.text: Marketing Cookies
Marketing cookies are only used where you have provided your explicit consent.

blocks.heading: These cookies may be used to
items: Avoid repeatedly displaying the same advertisements

blocks.heading: This information may include
items: Device location derived from IP address

Business OS enables customers to upload, create, import, store, organise, process and manage business information.

blocks.heading: Customer Uploaded Data may include

blocks.text: Ownership of Customer Uploaded Data remains with the respective customer.
AARVANTA does not acquire ownership rights over Customer Uploaded Data by virtue of providing the Platform.

blocks.heading: Customer Uploaded Data is processed solely
items: To comply with applicable legal obligations; and
To provide technical support where requested by the customer.

blocks.heading: We do not access Customer Uploaded Data except where
items: Access is necessary to provide support requested by the customer;
Access is required to investigate technical issues;
Access is necessary to maintain security;
Access is required by applicable law;
Access is authorised by the customer.

blocks.text: All personnel with authorised access are subject to strict confidentiality obligations.
Business OS includes artificial intelligence features designed to automate business processes and assist customers in carrying out business activities.
When customers choose to use AI-powered functionality, information submitted by the customer may be processed through AI technologies solely for the purpose of delivering the requested functionality.

blocks.heading: Examples include

blocks.text: AI processing is initiated only in response to user actions or customer-configured automations.

AARVANTA does not intentionally use Customer Uploaded Data to train proprietary artificial intelligence models unless the customer has provided explicit prior consent or such processing is otherwise permitted by applicable law and contractual agreement.
Customers remain responsible for reviewing AI-generated outputs before relying upon or distributing them.

Artificial intelligence systems may occasionally generate inaccurate, incomplete or unexpected outputs. Users should exercise independent judgment and verify important information before making business, financial, legal or operational decisions based upon AI-generated content.
We process personal data only where there is a lawful basis to do so and only for legitimate business purposes.

blocks.heading: Personal data may be processed for the following purposes
items: Sending marketing communications where consent has been obtained or another lawful basis applies;
Responding to lawful requests from public authorities;
Protecting the rights, safety and property of AARVANTA, our customers and third parties.

blocks.text: We will not process personal data for purposes incompatible with those described in this Privacy Policy unless required or permitted by applicable law.
Where UK GDPR or EU GDPR applies, AARVANTA processes personal data on one or more of the following lawful bases:
Performance of a Contract
Processing necessary to provide the Platform, manage user accounts, fulfil subscriptions, process payments and deliver contracted services.

blocks.heading: Legitimate Interests

blocks.text: Before relying upon legitimate interests, we assess and balance our interests against the rights and freedoms of affected individuals.

blocks.heading: Consent

blocks.text: Consent may be withdrawn at any time without affecting the lawfulness of processing carried out before its withdrawal.
Legal Obligation

Processing necessary to comply with applicable legal and regulatory obligations, including taxation, accounting, anti-fraud measures, court orders, law enforcement requests and other statutory requirements.
Vital Interests
Where necessary, personal data may be processed to protect the vital interests of an individual or another natural person.
AARVANTA does not sell, rent, lease or otherwise trade personal data to third parties for their independent marketing purposes.
Personal data is disclosed only where necessary to operate the Platform, fulfil contractual obligations, comply with legal requirements or protect legitimate business interests.

blocks.heading: Depending upon the nature of the services being used, personal data may be disclosed to
items: Law enforcement agencies where legally required
Business partners acting under contractual obligations
Successors in the event of a merger, acquisition or corporate restructuring

blocks.text: Every third party receiving personal data is required to process such information in accordance with contractual confidentiality obligations and applicable data protection legislation.
Third parties are not authorised to use personal data for their own commercial purposes unless they act as an independent data controller and have their own lawful basis for processing.
To provide the Platform efficiently and securely, AARVANTA engages carefully selected third-party service providers.
These providers perform services on our behalf and are granted access only to the extent necessary to perform those services.
Current categories of service providers include:
Cloud Infrastructure
Cloud hosting, servers, networking, storage, backups and disaster recovery.
Authentication Services
Secure user authentication, identity verification, session management and access control.
Payment Processing
Subscription billing, payment authorisation, invoicing, refunds and financial transaction management.

blocks.heading: Email Services
items: Marketing communications where consent has been provided

blocks.text: Customer Support
Support ticket management, troubleshooting, technical investigations and customer assistance.
Analytics

Artificial Intelligence Services

Where customers choose to use AI-powered features, information necessary to fulfil the requested functionality may be securely processed through authorised AI technologies acting on behalf of AARVANTA.
We seek to ensure that providers handling AI-related processing implement appropriate security measures and contractual safeguards consistent with applicable data protection laws.
Business OS is hosted using enterprise-grade cloud infrastructure designed to provide resilience, scalability and security.
Our hosting environment may include cloud infrastructure operated through Amazon Web Services (AWS) together with supporting deployment infrastructure operated through Vercel.
Infrastructure providers are selected based upon recognised industry security standards and their ability to support secure, reliable and highly available cloud services.

blocks.heading: Data may be stored, replicated and backed up across secure infrastructure for the purposes of

blocks.text: Where data is transferred outside the United Kingdom or European Economic Area, appropriate legal safeguards are implemented as described in this Privacy Policy.
Business OS uses Firebase Authentication to provide secure account authentication and identity management.

blocks.heading: Authentication services may include

blocks.text: Passwords are never stored in plain text.
Authentication credentials are protected using industry-recognised encryption and security practices.
Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their login credentials.
You must immediately notify AARVANTA if you become aware of any suspected unauthorised access to your account.
Subscription payments and other financial transactions are processed securely through Stripe.
AARVANTA does not store complete payment card numbers, card verification values (CVV), PINs or equivalent payment authentication information on its own systems.
Stripe is responsible for processing payment information in accordance with applicable payment industry standards, including the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS).

blocks.heading: Information received from Stripe may include

blocks.text: Payment information is processed solely for the purpose of providing subscribed services, fulfilling contractual obligations, preventing fraud and complying with financial reporting requirements.
As a global technology platform, certain personal data may be processed outside the United Kingdom or European Economic Area.

Where international transfers occur, AARVANTA implements appropriate safeguards designed to ensure that transferred personal data receives an equivalent level of protection required under applicable data protection legislation.

blocks.heading: These safeguards may include
items: UK Addendum to the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses
Transfers to jurisdictions benefiting from an adequacy decision
Additional technical and organisational safeguards where appropriate

blocks.text: International transfers are limited to what is necessary for providing the Platform, maintaining infrastructure, processing payments, authenticating users, delivering customer support and operating requested services.
Protecting personal data is fundamental to the operation of Business OS.

blocks.heading: AARVANTA maintains administrative, technical and physical safeguards designed to protect personal data against
Security measures include, where appropriate
items: Encryption of data in transit using modern Transport Layer Security (TLS)
Encryption of data at rest where appropriate
Multi-factor authentication for administrative access where implemented

blocks.text: No method of electronic transmission or storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure. While AARVANTA employs reasonable and appropriate safeguards, absolute security cannot be guaranteed.
Users are responsible for protecting their own account credentials and devices used to access the Platform.
AARVANTA maintains procedures for identifying, investigating, managing and responding to actual or suspected security incidents.

blocks.heading: Where a personal data breach occurs, we will
items: Assess the nature and scope of the incident;
Contain and mitigate the incident where reasonably practicable;
Notify affected customers where required by law or contractual obligation; and
Notify the relevant supervisory authority within applicable statutory timeframes where legally required.

blocks.text: We continually review and improve our security practices to reduce the likelihood and impact of future incidents.

Personal data is retained only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purposes for which it was collected, including satisfying legal, contractual, regulatory, accounting and operational requirements.

blocks.heading: Retention periods vary depending upon

blocks.text: When personal data is no longer required, it will be securely deleted, anonymised or irreversibly destroyed using methods appropriate to the nature of the information.
Customer-uploaded data is retained in accordance with the customer's subscription, account settings, contractual arrangements and applicable legal obligations.

blocks.heading: Following account termination, certain information may be retained for limited periods where necessary to
items: Protect the security and integrity of the Platform.

blocks.text: Subject to applicable law, you may exercise the rights described in this section in relation to your personal data.
These rights are not absolute and may be subject to legal exemptions, restrictions or conditions under applicable legislation.

Where AARVANTA acts solely as a Data Processor on behalf of a customer, requests relating to Customer Uploaded Data should ordinarily be directed to the relevant customer acting as the Data Controller. Where appropriate, AARVANTA will assist its customers in responding to such requests in accordance with applicable law and contractual obligations.
You have the right to request confirmation as to whether AARVANTA processes your personal data.

blocks.heading: Where personal data is processed, you may request access to
items: The categories of personal data being processed;
The categories of recipients to whom the data has been disclosed;
The anticipated retention period or the criteria used to determine that period;
Information relating to international data transfers;
The source of the personal data where it was not collected directly from you;
Information regarding your statutory rights; and
A copy of the personal data undergoing processing.

blocks.text: Requests that are manifestly unfounded, excessive or repetitive may be refused or may be subject to a reasonable administrative fee where permitted by applicable law.
You have the right to request that inaccurate or incomplete personal data be corrected without undue delay.
You are responsible for ensuring that information maintained within your account remains accurate and current.

Certain account information may be updated directly through your account settings. Where information cannot be amended through the Platform, you may submit a request using the contact details provided in this Privacy Policy.

blocks.heading: You may request the deletion of your personal data where
items: The information is no longer necessary for the purpose for which it was collected;
You withdraw consent and there is no other lawful basis for processing;
The personal data has been unlawfully processed; or
Erasure is required to comply with a legal obligation.

blocks.heading: AARVANTA may decline to erase personal data where continued processing is required for
items: Establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims;
Public interest reasons recognised by law; or
Other lawful exemptions under applicable data protection legislation.

blocks.text: Deletion of your account may result in the permanent removal of associated data, subject to any applicable retention obligations.

blocks.heading: You may request that processing of your personal data be restricted where
items: The accuracy of the data is contested;
Processing is unlawful but erasure is not requested;
The data is required for legal claims;
An objection to processing is pending determination.

blocks.text: Where processing has been restricted, personal data may continue to be stored but will generally not be processed except where authorised by law or with your consent.

Where processing is based upon consent or contractual necessity and carried out by automated means, you may request a copy of your personal data in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format.
Where technically feasible, and where permitted by law, you may also request that such information be transmitted directly to another data controller.
You have the right to object to processing based upon legitimate interests where your particular circumstances justify such an objection.
Where processing is carried out for direct marketing purposes, you may object at any time.
Upon receipt of a valid objection relating to direct marketing, processing for that purpose will cease without undue delay.
Business OS incorporates artificial intelligence and automated technologies designed to assist users in carrying out business processes.
These technologies support customer-directed activities such as workflow automation, content generation, document analysis, customer communications and operational efficiencies.

Unless expressly stated otherwise, AARVANTA does not make decisions producing legal effects or similarly significant consequences concerning individuals solely by automated means without appropriate human involvement where required by applicable law.
Where automated processing is used, appropriate safeguards are implemented in accordance with applicable legislation.
Users remain responsible for reviewing and validating AI-generated outputs before relying upon them for business, legal, financial or operational decisions.

In the event of a proposed or completed merger, acquisition, investment, restructuring, financing, sale of assets or other corporate transaction, personal data may be disclosed or transferred where reasonably necessary for evaluating, negotiating or completing such transaction.
Any successor organisation receiving personal data will remain subject to obligations consistent with this Privacy Policy and applicable law unless affected individuals are otherwise notified.

Investigate fraud, security incidents or unlawful activity;

blocks.text: Any such disclosure will be limited to the extent reasonably necessary and permitted by applicable law.
